pending_ideas.hook: She flips a plastic laundry basket upside down into a tub of wet concrete, pushing it down until grey sludge oozes through every weave hole.
pending_ideas.why: TIER 1 water feature with the scale advantage (baskets are big, cheap, ubiquitous) and a hard middle that looks like destruction—the grid pattern will preserve beautifully and viewers will stay to see if water actually pools in it.
pending_ideas.tr: Çamaşır sepetini betonla kaplıyor, bahçe için su havuzu yapıyor.

pending_ideas.hook: She coils a cracked rubber garden hose into a spiral, then pours concrete directly into the center until the entire coil disappears under grey cement.
pending_ideas.why: TIER 1 water feature combining instant recognition (every gardener has a dead hose) with the hard irreversible middle—pouring concrete into/over the coil looks like total destruction, but the spiral shape promises a fountain payoff that will hold retention.
pending_ideas.tr: Eski bahçe hortumunu spiral şeklinde sarıp beton döküyor, fıskiyeli çeşme yapıyor.

pending_ideas.hook: She submerges a large woven wicker basket face-down into a bucket of concrete, holding it underwater as bubbles escape and the weave turns dark grey.
pending_ideas.why: TIER 1 water feature hitting the scale/water advantage—wicker is worthless when broken, the dipping moment looks violent and irreversible, and every intricate weave line will cast perfectly to hold viewers through the reveal.
pending_ideas.tr: Hasır sepeti betonun içine batırıp kuş banyosu yapıyor, her örgü detayı taş oluyor.

pending_ideas.hook: She dips an old leather jacket with zippers and pockets into a vat of concrete, submerging sleeves-first until the whole garment sinks grey and heavy.
pending_ideas.why: TIER 2 coated garment that hits the proven 18k-29k view range—leather is instantly recognizable, zippers/pockets/collar provide detail retention like denim, and the dipping moment delivers the hard middle that makes viewers think she destroyed something valuable.
pending_ideas.tr: Eski deri ceketi betonun içine batırıyor, fermuarlar ve cepler taş heykel oluyor.

pending_ideas.hook: She opens a rusty metal toolbox, pours concrete directly into every compartment and tray until all the small dividers flood grey, then slams the lid shut.
pending_ideas.why: TIER 2 because it's recognizable junk with preserved detail (handle, latch, tray slots will all cast) and the pouring-then-closing moment gives the hard irreversible middle—viewers stay wondering if those compartments actually survived as planter sections.
pending_ideas.tr: Paslı alet kutusunun bölmelerine beton doldurup kapağını kapatıyor, çiçek saksısı oluyor.
